gaps.explanation: Schedule ABOVE the statement by 160,638 = exactly the Debt Service Fund budget schedule disbursements. Per fund, statement p5 (printed p9) Total expenditures vs detail: General 380,156 = General schedule pp12-13 380,156; Street 120,194 = Street schedule p14 120,194; Swimming Pool 38,413 = p18 38,413; Other Governmental Funds 144,068 = nonmajor combining p21 (Park 31,690 + Library 129 + Cemetery 23,639 + Fitness Center 4,986 + Library Board 65,109 + Parks and Recreation Board 1,524 + Community Ambulance 16,991 = 144,068); Debt Service Fund: statement column blank (0) vs Debt Service budget schedule p16 (printed p42) Total disbursements 160,638 = Bond retirement 105,000 + Interest on bonds 55,238 + Agent fees 400 (detail lines in the Debt Service Fund schedule). The governmental funds statement p6 (printed p10) prints the same money under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) in the Debt Service column: Debt principal payments (105,000) and Debt interest payments (55,638) = 55,238 + 400; the JSON statement holds it in other_financing (-249,570), not in disbursements. Detail sum 380,156 + 120,194 + 160,638 + 38,413 + 144,068 = 843,469 = schedule_total; statement 682,831. Nothing counted twice (detail has no Debt Service Fund other-financing debt lines), nothing missing; the schedule lines are printed and stay.

Schedule BELOW the statement by 21,569 = Water Fund 'Debt payments'. Proprietary statement p8 (printed p12) prints Debt payments (21,569) under NONOPERATING REVENUES (EXPENSES) and the JSON counts it in business-type disbursements (operating expenditures 156,552 + debt payments 21,569 + interest expense 16,976 = 195,097). The Water Enterprise budget schedule p19 (printed p45) prints Debt payments (21,569) under OTHER FINANCING USES, and detail holds it there as an other-financing line (Water Enterprise Fund 'Debt payments' -21,569). Detail expenditures: Water 137,776 (p19 Total disbursements, incl. interest expense 16,976) + Sewer 35,752 (p20) = 173,528; + 21,569 = 195,097. The money is already in detail; it is only printed in a different section, so no line is added.
